call_date_range.basis: Go-live: first dialler run on Wednesday 14 October 2026 (minutes item 1). The example `now` is 2026-10-14T11:00. No end date is given.

callback.text: 3rd business day after call date only

rule.round: up to the next multiple of 5

attempt_ladder.date_rule: the next business day after the call date

identity.retry_rule: one wrong answer per question may be asked again
one wrong answer per question may be asked again

outcomes.when: get_account fails; two failed create_promise tries, or get_account failing; system failure
identity of person unclear after second ask; wrong number, deceased, unclear who answered; someone else answered, no callback; wrong number; deceased; could not tell who answered; not reached
security check failed; security questions failed; failed check
declines security questions; before verification; customer would not answer the security questions; declined questions
insists on a person; transferred to a person on request (queue general); general queue
hardship transfer; transferred to Customer Care, hardship (queue support); support queue
hardship, declined Customer Care; hardship, customer did not want Customer Care; hardship, declined transfer
after verification; no arrangement; turned down; no second-look booked; or would not continue after security questions; turned down, no second look
at least one arrangement recorded, no transfer after it, every arrangement for the full overdue amount; all arrangements full amount
at least one arrangement recorded, no transfer after it, at least one for less than overdue amount; at least one part arrangement
every product claimed as already paid, nothing recorded; every product claimed paid
no arrangement; turned down; second-look call booked; second look booked
someone else answered, callback booked; third-party callback booked

number of attempts made and last offer (amount and date)
